name: @decks/e2e
description: The browser checks, driven with Playwright against a throwaway copy of example/.

scripts.typecheck: node --check run.mjs && node --check harness.mjs && node -e "for (const f of require('node:fs').readdirSync('checks')) require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'checks/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
